_comment: TWO RECORDED ANTHROPIC ASSISTANT TURNS FROM A web_fetch_20250910 TOOL-USE LOOP.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (D-B, run d6bb3aae, 2026-07-27). The own-researcher stream
failed 6 of 6 sessions with:
BadRequestError: 400 invalid_request_error
messages.N.content.M.web_fetch_tool_result.content.RequestWebFetchToolResultError:
Input does not match the expected shape.
Read the path: messages.N is a PRIOR turn being echoed back, and the offending block is
the ERROR variant of a web_fetch result. The stream worked until a fetch failed; then the
malformed error result was replayed into every subsequent request and each one 400'd.
WHY CI MISSED IT. tests/test_engine_e2e_stubbed.py stubs the provider, so it can never
produce Anthropic's real server-tool ERROR payload — the exact shape that broke. This
fixture is that payload, committed, so the regression is reproducible offline with no
network, no key and no spend.
PROVENANCE OF THE SHAPE. Reconstructed from (a) the literal 400 path quoted above, which
names the block type, the nesting depth and the union member; (b) the web_fetch_20250910
block contract documented in pipeline/tribunal/tools.py; (c) the fields the existing
serialiser and pipeline/tribunal/skeptic.py::_collect_citation_urls already read
(web_fetch_tool_result.content.url, text.citations[].url). It is shape-faithful, not a
byte capture of one specific HTTP response — no recorded body survived the aborted run.
HOW THE TEST USES IT. tests/test_web_fetch_replay.py rehydrates these dicts into small
objects carrying __dict__, INCLUDING the nested `content` value. That is the whole point:
the dict path through _content_to_serialisable was never broken, the OBJECT path was, and
a fixture replayed as plain dicts would prove nothing.
DO NOT bump this to web_fetch_20260209. That version requires the code-execution tool,
which this engine deliberately does not enable (tools.py, ADR-006 GOTCHA).
